'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Mark VanDriel DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mark VanDriel]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
